title: console analytics: a formula declared returnType currency renders as a bare number, a KPI tile cannot show its description, percent fields always draw a progress bar, and report charts cannot split a series by a second dimension
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.2.0** while implementing hotcrm#2370, its dashboards and number-formats card. The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2370 comment 6489085271](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2370#issuecomment-6489085271), and the HotCRM side is hotcrm#2379 (merged as `c362ccd`). HotCRM shipped everything it could inside 18.2.0. Each row below is the half it could not.

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Evidence | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A `Field.formula` with `returnType: 'currency'` (the spec key added by #22727) renders as a bare grouped number in list cells, related lists and the record page: a line's Total reads "24,000" beside its Sales Price "$6,000.00". | HotCRM `crm_quote_line_item.total_price` and `crm_opportunity_line_item.total_price` since hotcrm#2379, tenant currency USD. | The console's formula cell reads `returnType` and draws a currency result with the currency face a `currency` field uses. |
| 2 | A `metric` dashboard tile prints the measure's label (for example "Total Amount") under its value. The widget's `description`, which says what the number counts, is not shown on the tile. | HotCRM Service and Sales dashboards; the card's row 2 asked each KPI to state its base. | Show the widget `description` as the tile caption when one is declared, and fall back to the measure label. |
| 3 | `Field.percent` always draws a progress bar in list cells and on the record page. No field or page key turns it off, so a probability or rate that is not progress reads as a bar. | HotCRM opportunity `probability` and campaign rates. Related: #5066 (closed, chip clipping). | A display key on the field (or the view column) that shows the plain percentage. |
| 4 | A report chart takes one `xAxis` dimension and one `yAxis` measure, so it cannot split a series by a second dimension (a bar per rep, split by stage). A `summary` report with two `rows` levels repeats the outer value on every inner row and shows no group subtotal; the spec has no subtotal key. | HotCRM `opportunity_funnel_owner_stage`, which hotcrm#2379 turned into an owner × stage `matrix` with a bar per owner as the workaround. | A `series` (or `groupBy`) dimension on the report chart, and per-group subtotals on a multi-level summary. |

**Not filed:** a dataset `sum` over a formula field answers `DATASET_INVALID`. That is the ruled behaviour (#24426: store the value as a number field), so HotCRM renamed its tile to say it sums catalog list prices.

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, as a card of its own where it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2370's report. Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for formula currency face, metric tile caption/description, percent progress bar, report series by second dimension and summary subtotals. Related: #22727 (closed, the spec half of row 1), #5066 (closed), #27188 (record-mode currency, a different gap). No open card.</sub>
